research_contract: Startup is fully informed: ingest the current artifact, any required startup delta, and the Main Lines before research begins.
During mathematical research, workers self-police the no-consultation rule and keep intermediate reasoning local.
Publish only after substantial progress, as one coherent batch; connector-size limits are handled by numbered staging chunks.
review_staged_batch() is a required concurrency barrier: inspect other-session findings since startup and resolve semantic overlap before commit.
commit_staged_batch() requires overlap_checked=true and refuses if another session published after the review, forcing a fresh review.
